commands.name: /tips
commands.summary: Show a rotating security/UX tip

commands.summary: Who's online (with away/status)

commands.name: /watch
commands.summary: Alert on a keyword in **any** room, like a mention

commands.name: /ban
commands.summary: Owner moderation — bound to the public key, so a rename does not undo a ban

commands.name: /block
commands.summary: Stop seeing someone, **just for you**. Nothing is sent, the relay never learns, and they are not told — so anyone can use it, including in `general`, which has no owner. Works in P2P too, where there is no moderation at all.

commands.name: /blocklist
commands.summary: Stop seeing someone, **just for you**. Nothing is sent, the relay never learns, and they are not told — so anyone can use it, including in `general`, which has no owner. Works in P2P too, where there is no moderation at all.

commands.name: /create
commands.summary: Create a **private room** 🔒 — see below

commands.name: /join
commands.summary: Open a room as a **new buffer** — you stay in your other rooms (IRC style)

commands.name: /kick
commands.summary: Owner moderation — bound to the public key, so a rename does not undo a ban

commands.name: /leave
commands.summary: Leave a room; its buffer closes (the last room is protected)

commands.name: /mute
commands.summary: Owner moderation — bound to the public key, so a rename does not undo a ban

commands.name: /owner
commands.summary: Room owner

commands.name: /room
commands.summary: Current room, how it is sending it, and your buffer list

commands.name: /rooms
commands.summary: List rooms (🔒 marks private ones)

commands.name: /topic
commands.summary: Show or set the room topic — shown in the status bar and synced to whoever joins later

commands.name: /unblock
commands.summary: Stop seeing someone, **just for you**. Nothing is sent, the relay never learns, and they are not told — so anyone can use it, including in `general`, which has no owner. Works in P2P too, where there is no moderation at all.

commands.name: /audit
commands.summary: Local audit log

commands.name: /autolock
commands.summary: Lock the screen behind the session passphrase — manually or after idle time (`autoLock` in config). Privacy for the "stepped away" moment; `/panic` is for the worst one

commands.name: /backup
commands.summary: Encrypted backup of identity + verified peers (restore at startup)

commands.name: /contacts
commands.summary: Contact book — persistent aliases on trust records ("this fingerprint is João"); shows in `/users`, rides along in identity backups

commands.name: /cover
commands.summary: Cover traffic — `on` = jittered decoys, `constant` = steady-rate paced channel

commands.name: /deniable
commands.summary: Plausible-deniability mode

commands.name: /device
commands.summary: Your devices under one identity. The identity key never leaves the device that holds it, so a second device is granted a signed place on the list rather than a copy of your identity

commands.name: /ephemeral
commands.summary: Self-destructing messages

commands.name: /fingerprint
commands.summary: Key fingerprint, the identity fingerprint when there is one, and a deterministic **randomart** picture of the key

commands.name: /lock
commands.summary: Lock the screen behind the session passphrase — manually or after idle time (`autoLock` in config). Privacy for the "stepped away" moment; `/panic` is for the worst one

commands.name: /panic
commands.summary: Duress wipe — securely erase all on-disk secrets (session, history, trust, keys) and exit

commands.name: /receipts
commands.summary: Send read receipts (✓✓)

commands.name: /theme
commands.summary: Nick colour theme: neon, matrix, mono, sunset, ocean

commands.name: /trust
commands.summary: Accept new key / trust status

commands.name: /trustlist
commands.summary: Accept new key / trust status

commands.name: /verify
commands.summary: SAS code (~40-bit) + QR + key randomart for out-of-band verification; says whether the code is over identity keys or device keys

commands.name: /verify-confirm
commands.summary: Mark peer as verified

commands.name: /accept
commands.summary: Accept / decline an incoming file offer

commands.name: /doctor
commands.summary: Diagnose why a connection fails: address, DNS, TCP port, TLS (CA vs self-signed) and protocol version — each failure with what to do about it

commands.name: /export
commands.summary: Export history as .txt or .json (plaintext!)

commands.name: /file
commands.summary: Offer a file (≤ 50MB) — the recipient must `/accept`; transfers resume

commands.name: /find
commands.summary: Search **this room's scrollback** and press Enter to **jump to the message**, highlighted

commands.name: /history
commands.summary: Last n messages from history

commands.name: /img
commands.summary: Render the last received image in **full resolution** (kitty/iTerm2)

commands.name: /play
commands.summary: Play the last received voice note (`afplay`/`sox`/`ffplay`)

commands.name: /reject
commands.summary: Accept / decline an incoming file offer

commands.name: /retention
commands.summary: Purge local history older than the given age

commands.name: /search
commands.summary: Search the encrypted local history (on disk, across sessions)

commands.name: /voice
commands.summary: Record & send an encrypted voice note (needs `sox`/`ffmpeg`; default 10s)

commands.name: /autoaway
commands.summary: Go away by itself after that long without typing (1–240 minutes)

commands.summary: Mark yourself away — while away, unreads are counted (`[away · N new]`) and `/back` shows a summary

commands.name: /back
